versions.subject: rule: susp svchost sub process
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
    ParentImage|endswith: '\svchost.exe'
    User|contains: # covers many language settings for Network Service. Please expand
        - 'NETWORK SERVICE'
        - 'NETZWERKDIENST'
        - 'SERVIZIO DI RETE'
        - 'SERVICIO DE RED'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*\\svchost.exe" ParentImage="*\\svchost.exe" User IN ("*NETWORK SERVICE*", "*NETZWERKDIENST*", "*SERVIZIO DI RETE*", "*SERVICIO DE RED*")
